prbcAccess.how: When someone in a group writes "can't add a new outlet" or sends the "no 1C connection" screenshot, the bot checks them in PRBC: active account, role, primary department, Integrations access (Employee) and the 1C sales rep code. It grants what is missing, asks the employee for their rep code, finds it in the 1C list and links it. The worker checks all sales reps regularly.
prbcAccess.botHint: The bot answers "can't add an outlet" with the real PRBC state

prbcAccess.mappingNote: The rep code (1C sales rep) is never guessed: when the employee writes, the bot asks for it, finds it in the 1C list and links it. A code linked to another employee is left alone.
